upstream_only.router.py: bot HTTP routes; the server exposes Compile through openviking/server/routers/compile.py
upstream_only.sandbox.py: bot sandbox credentials; in-server Compile has no command execution
upstream_only.service.py: bot task runtime; replaced by runner.py on the durable ExternalTask queue
upstream_only.store.py: bot-local task status store; tasks live on the ExternalTask queue

diverged.models.py: drops bot request/task models; CompileFailure carries a diagnostic result
diverged.pipeline_agent.py: drops the bot AgentLoop adapter; agent_loop.py runs child agents
diverged.skill_resources.py: no local Skill copies for scripts, since nothing executes them
diverged.ops/map.py: no Skill-script hint in the Map prompt
diverged.plan.py: decodes JSON-encoded objects some providers send for nested arguments
diverged.pipeline.py: names the first job failure when no final artifact remains
